scripts.format: prettier --write . && uv run --project bridges/youtube-music ruff format bridges/youtube-music
scripts.format:check: prettier --check . && uv run --project bridges/youtube-music ruff format --check bridges/youtube-music
scripts.lint: eslint . && uv run --project bridges/youtube-music ruff check bridges/youtube-music
scripts.test:python: uv run --project bridges/youtube-music python -m unittest discover -s bridges/youtube-music/test -p 'test_*.py'
